_ipadapter_note: 0.0, not the 0.6 house default. Measured on this film: a full-body reference sheet on a flat grey field at 0.6 injected its own background and its own dress into every beat that had a character, and beats without one were richly painted - the film had two looks and the divider was whether she was in the shot. Swept 0.0/0.2/0.4/0.6 on three beats (studio/samples/the_film/probe_ipa.py): monotone destruction of place and wardrobe. Every keyframe shipped here was rendered at 0.0 by reroll.py, which forced it at runtime while this file still said 0.6.
